html:
Tokentrim Python 3.9 Requirement

You need Python 3.9 or newer to run Tokentrim, a free and open-source local toolkit that helps you optimize your Claude Code usage. Tokentrim's features can help you save on your Claude Code costs by trimming tool output, reading files in ranges, and spooling long output to disk.

Getting Started with Tokentrim

To get started with Tokentrim, you first need to ensure you have Python 3.9 or a newer version installed on your machine. You can then install Tokentrim as a plugin or in full via git clone.

What You Get with Tokentrim

With Tokentrim, you get a range of features for free, including all hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, and cold-cache alert. You can also upgrade to Pro for a one-time payment of $49 or $9/month, which adds a hosted dashboard on any device, Monday digest, weekly budget with alert at 80%, Slack totals, and support for up to 3 machines.

FAQ

What are the benefits of using Tokentrim? Tokentrim can help you save on your Claude Code costs by summarizing earlier conversations and trimming tool output. On the author's 135 real conversations, Tokentrim cut history re-read by 75% and made limits last 4.0x longer. How do I know if Tokentrim is working for me? You can use the replay command to see your own numbers and track your savings. Is my data secure with Tokentrim? Yes, nothing leaves your machine by default, so your data is secure.

Next Steps

Now that you know Tokentrim requires Python 3.9 or newer, you can Install Tokentrim now to start optimizing your Claude Code usage and saving on costs.
